Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 13

“Then conches, kettledrums, tabors, drums, and horns were suddenly sounded together, and the sound became tumultuous.”

A cascade of instruments erupts across the battlefield — the Gita opens not in silence but in a wall of sound, setting an almost cinematic tone before a single arrow is fired.
